subject: dsa
title: Selection Sort
summary: Scan the unsorted part for its smallest value, then swap that value to the front of the unsorted part. Repeat until everything is placed.
problem: Sort ascending by repeatedly selecting the smallest remaining value and placing it at the front of the unsorted region.

steps.caption: Selection sort: scan the unsorted part for the smallest value, then swap it to the front of that part.
Pass 1: the smallest of all four values is 1, at index 1.
Swap it into index 0. The front is now sorted.
Pass 2: the smallest of the rest (5, 4, 2) is 2, at index 3.
Swap it into index 1. Two values settled.
Pass 3: the smallest of the rest (4, 5) is 4, already in place.
Nothing to move, and the last value falls in line too. Sorted: [1, 2, 4, 5].
